name: Mankind Pharma Ltd
tagline: India's 4th-largest domestic pharma company by rank, a steady double-digit compounder now too large for a 10x/100x framing
business_overview: Mankind Pharma is a leading Indian domestic-formulations pharma company (chronic + acute therapies, consumer OTC brands like Manforce, Prega News, Gas-O-Fast) that acquired Bharat Serums and Vaccines (BSV) in mid-2024 for Rs 13,630 Cr, adding speciality/international exposure.
fundamentals_table: FY26 Q4: Revenue +12% YoY, EBITDA +33% (margin expansion 22.3%->26.4%), PAT +30%, net debt down from Rs 5,784 Cr to Rs 3,932 Cr (deleveraging)
fundamentals_narrative: Consistent 10-14% quarterly revenue growth with steady gross-margin expansion (68%->72.6% over 3 years) and active balance-sheet deleveraging post the large BSV acquisition. Solid, unspectacular quality metrics for a company of this scale.
